source.@value:
pipeline "UniFi GIM"
stage 0 match all
  rule "UniFi - initialize mixed input"
stage 1 match either
  rule "UniFi - detect CEF"
  rule "UniFi - detect device syslog"
  rule "UniFi - retain malformed input"
stage 10 match either
  rule "UniFi - parse CEF"
  rule "UniFi - parse device syslog header"
stage 20 match either
  rule "UniFi - normalize CEF client connected"
  rule "UniFi - normalize CEF client disconnected"
  rule "UniFi - normalize switch port link"
  rule "UniFi - normalize switch spanning tree"
  rule "UniFi - normalize wireless client associated"
  rule "UniFi - normalize wireless client disassociated"
  rule "UniFi - normalize wireless mesh timeout"
  rule "UniFi - normalize device reboot"
  rule "UniFi - normalize syslog priority"
  rule "UniFi - continue vendor normalization"
stage 30 match all
  rule "UniFi - normalize severity to GIM"
stage 40 match all
  rule "UniFi - route normalized messages"
stage 41 match either
  rule "UniFi - route unsupported messages"
  rule "UniFi - route CEF messages"
  rule "UniFi - route syslog messages"
end

rule "UniFi - retain malformed input"
when
  has_field("unifi_ingest") &&
  regex(
    pattern: "(?:^|\\s)(CEF:\\d+\\|Ubiquiti\\|UniFi Network\\|.*)$",
    value: to_string($message.message)
  ).matches == false &&
  regex(
    pattern: "^(?:<\\d+>)?[^ ]+ [0-9A-Fa-f]{12},.+-\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+\\+\\d+:",
    value: to_string($message.message)
  ).matches == false
then
  route_to_stream(name: "UniFi - Unsupported", remove_from_default: false);
end

rule "UniFi - route syslog messages"
when
  has_field("unifi_log_format") && to_string($message.unifi_log_format) == "syslog"
then
  route_to_stream(name: "UniFi - Syslog", remove_from_default: false);
end

rule "UniFi - detect device syslog"
when
  has_field("unifi_ingest") &&
  regex(
    pattern: "^(?:<\\d+>)?[^ ]+ [0-9A-Fa-f]{12},.+-\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+\\+\\d+:",
    value: to_string($message.message)
  ).matches == true
then
  set_field("unifi_log_format", "syslog");
  set_field("unifi_parse_status", "detected");
end

rule "UniFi - detect CEF"
when
  has_field("unifi_ingest") &&
  regex(
    pattern: "(?:^|\\s)(CEF:\\d+\\|Ubiquiti\\|UniFi Network\\|.*)$",
    value: to_string($message.message)
  ).matches == true
then
  set_field("unifi_log_format", "cef");
  set_field("unifi_parse_status", "detected");
end

rule "UniFi - continue vendor normalization"
when
  has_field("unifi_log_format") && to_string($message.unifi_log_format) != "unknown"
then
  set_field("unifi_pipeline_stage", "normalized");
end

rule "UniFi - route unsupported messages"
when
  has_field("unifi_parse_status") && to_string($message.unifi_parse_status) != "parsed"
then
  route_to_stream(name: "UniFi - Unsupported", remove_from_default: false);
end

rule "UniFi - route normalized messages"
when
  has_field("unifi_ingest") && to_bool($message.unifi_ingest)
then
  route_to_stream(name: "UniFi - Parsed", remove_from_default: false);
end

rule "UniFi - route CEF messages"
when
  has_field("unifi_log_format") && to_string($message.unifi_log_format) == "cef"
then
  route_to_stream(name: "UniFi - CEF", remove_from_default: false);
end
